Asha (PM): quick check-in: UX research flagged that people don't notice the inline "peek" for extra metrics in compare rows. it's subtle and not keyboard-discoverable. options: make peek persistent, add explicit control, or rely on hover (which fails keyboard). thoughts? Rene (Design): i sketched a 'peek' affordance that sits under the row as a thin bar that appears on hover/focus. it contains p50, p99, cost and a tiny 'more' link. goal: visible on keyboard focus too. visual: 28px height, microcopy on the link: "see more metrics". Tom (Frontend): implementation notes: we can render the peek container only when focused/hovered to keep DOM light. for keyboard we need a tabbable target — either the whole row or a small inline button. prefer a dedicated button with aria-expanded so screen readers understand state. code sketch: ```html
...metrics...
``` Marta (A11y): must ensure the peek is exposed to assistive tech. hidden attribute hides from AT; better to use aria-hidden toggles and move focus into the container when opened. also announce when it opens: `aria-live` region with "Metrics peek opened for ". contrast: microtext in the bar needs 4.5:1. Asha (PM): good, we want parity across input modes. Rene, one question: the 'more' link leads to side panel; does it duplicate info? research says users want a quick glance without opening the panel. keep peek concise. Rene (Design): yes, keep it summary-only. 3 metrics + tiny delta chips. the 'more' action opens side panel for full history. i'll provide two mocks: (1) peek-button visible as small pill; (2) peek-on-row focus with inline button. Tom (Frontend): micro-interaction detail: when keyboard opens peek, focus should go to first interactive element inside peek (eg delta tooltip button). closing should return focus to the peek-toggle. avoid focus traps. use requestAnimationFrame for smooth height transition; respect reduced-motion media query. Marta (A11y): ensure peek-toggle has accessible name like "Show quick metrics for ". For screen reader users, also offer a shortcut in row context menu. test with NVDA/VO. Asha (PM): decision for prototype: implement peek-toggle button + aria-expanded + aria-live announce. Rene will push mocks with the pill variant. Tom to prototype behind flag. Marta & UX research to run three quick keyboard/voiceover sessions. ci-bot: CI pipeline started for branch feat/peek-toggle-prototype by Tom. build: queued. Tom (Frontend): i'll include a small A/B: visible pill vs hidden-on-hover to compare discoverability. will ping when PR ready. Marta (A11y): checklist before merge: 1) peek-toggle accessible name, 2) focus management tested, 3) aria-live announcements present, 4) contrast meets 4.5:1, 5) mobile tap semantics handled. i'll review the PR. Asha (PM): awesome. aim to ship to dev flag next week and run rapid sessions. thanks all. :raised_hands:
